result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few elements look visually clipped or obscured, mostly around horizontally scrollable content and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlays the restaurant feed content. The second restaurant card image is partially hidden behind the nav area, making the page feel cut off at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to or greater than the bottom navigation height, including the safe-area inset.

issues.description: A partially visible empty-looking category chip appears at the far right of the category row after “Healthy,” which looks like a broken or clipped pill.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal carousel spacing or clipping so the next chip is either meaningfully visible with text or not shown at all.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is heavily clipped at the right edge, including the restaurant name, which can look visually broken if not clearly intended as a horizontal carousel.
issues.suggestion: Consider showing a stronger carousel affordance, reducing card width, or ensuring partially visible cards still reveal enough content to look intentional.
